title: App emphasis-dial interaction logic (pipe_hit, dial wrap, lane keys, toast) has zero automated coverage
evidence: app/main.odin:316 "pipe_hit :: proc(app: ^App, wx, wy: f32) -> (u32, bool) {"; app/main.odin:368 "cycle_emphasis :: proc(app: ^App, pipe: u32) {"; app/main.odin:374 "next := u16((idx + 1) % i32(len(cat.balance.lane_presets)))"; app/main.odin:400 "set_lane_key :: proc(app: ^App, lane: u8) {"; app/main.odin:494 "if app.last_reject != .None && app.tick - app.reject_tick < 30 { // ~1.5s at 20Hz"; spec-3-2-lane-qos.md acceptance: "Given the app, when the player right-clicks a pipe, then the emphasis cycles through the balance.json presets and the lane-proportions readout updates."; no app/*_test.odin exists (verified: 'ls app/*_test.odin' -> No such file or directory)

title: Harness emphasis/lane directive error paths (parse + lowering) are untested — happy-path-only coverage
evidence: harness/run.odin:57 "return fmt.tprintf("demo %s: unknown lane preset %q", demo.name, d.preset)"; harness/run.odin:68 "return fmt.tprintf("demo %s: unknown class %q", demo.name, d.class)"; harness/run.odin:72 "return fmt.tprintf("demo %s: unknown lane %q (want express|standard|best_effort)", demo.name, d.lane)"; harness/demo.odin:261 "return {}, fmt.tprintf("bad emphasis at-line (want: at <n>ms emphasis <pipe> <preset>): %s", line)"; no harness/*_test.odin exists; only qos_emphasis.dem exercises the verbs (happy path)
detail: All emphasis/lane directive error paths fail loudly in code but nothing exercises them — every demo uses valid directives only; the guard's 'unknown preset/class/lane not failing loudly' class is unpinned. P3 tooling gap.
recommended_fix: Add one harness negative case per directive: demos with an unknown preset/class/lane and malformed at-lines must fail loudly with the named error, asserted by a script or test.
